organization_jan_tourism.role: Representative in Benelux and the UAE
organization_jan_tourism.description: JAN Tourism Consultancy introduces Ada Tours to travel companies in Benelux and the UAE. Its partner page covers Brazil and Latin America travel offerings, trip materials and contact details for Anna Avanesova.

organization_reps_unlimited.description: Ada Tours appears in the REPS Unlimited DMC network as an inbound operator for Brazil and Latin America. The profile introduces agents to private, family and group journeys, specialist programs and incentive travel.

organization_global_destinations.description: Global Destinations represents Ada Tours in the Indian market for sales and marketing. The partnership involves travel-industry outreach, introducing itineraries to partners and supporting the planning of Latin American journeys.

organization_abav_rj.description: The official ABAV-RJ directory lists Ada Tours as a current member of the association. The profile includes the company's legal name, CNPJ and official website.

organization_majunke.description: Majunke International Sales represents Ada Tours in the German travel market. The agency publishes a dedicated Ada Tours page for travel professionals arranging journeys in Brazil and Latin America.

organization_unique_promotion.description: Unique Promotion works with hotels and inbound travel businesses in the Russian market. Ada Tours appears among its clients on the representative's official website.
